comments.author: @dannii_L
comments.text:
Atlas Is Always Watching...
The way New Atlas moves is eerily reminiscent of how "evil" robots are often depicted in movies. This unsettling movement pattern, where the robot's facing direction is independent of its motion, has become a hallmark of the "evil robot" archetype. It taps into the primal fear of being constantly watched, a concept extensively explored in horror media through paintings with eyes that follow you and dolls that always seem to be staring. While technologically impressive, New Atlas' fluid movements inadvertently trigger a visceral unease, making it look absolutely terrifying.
